description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'PolicyIdNotExplicitlySettableException' used within the Eclipse Ditto framework to indicate errors related to setting a policy ID during REST requests. It includes constructors, static factory methods, and a builder for creating instances of this exception, and it extends DittoRuntimeException while implementing PolicyException.
